note: Defaults derived from the KiCad files (decaps: ICs in the same schematic sheet on the same supply; critical: net classes, crystal nets, differential pairs by name). Save as <board>.json and edit: a decap value is one IC ref (or {ic, maxMm}); critical entries take nets / pair / class plus kind, maxLengthMm, maxVias, maxMismatchMm, keepoutMm, layer, priority.
